text: {"assertions":["A spurious HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) error appeared in the API gateway rate limiter on the staging read replica.","The root cause was a timezone-naive datetime being compared against a timezone-aware datetime, causing throttle counters to exceed their configured ceiling.","The fix involved making all boundary datetimes timezone-aware at the edge in api/gateway/rate_limit.go.","The fix was submitted as PR #2749 on the branch fix/spurious-429-1.","The issue could be reproduced by replaying a saved burst fixture.","The rate limiting tests are located in api/gateway/rate_limit_test.go.","The backlog cleared 44 minutes after deploying the fix."]}
